claims.claim_text: The indexed Marcel Delhomme is a high-confidence match to the French sous-lieutenant of that name documented as serving with OSS in 1944.

claims.evidence_paraphrase: The exact name, French junior-officer rank and OSS context align with the index row.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from three matching identifiers beyond surname: full given name, French rank and OSS service.
claims.temporal_assessment: The award account covers OSS operations in 1944; it provides no pre-OSS employer.
claims.match_notes: This match does not distinguish the two same-name GR 16 P dossiers.
